title: Amazon Linux 2023 - ALAS2023-2026-3387: Important priority package update for jackson-databind
description:
Package updates are available for Amazon Linux 2023 that fix the following vulnerabilities:
CVE-2026-110879:
	PolymorphicTypeValidator bypass via generic type arguments and array element types in jackson-databind allows arbitrary class instantiation (incomplete fix for CVE-2026-54512) [CVE-2026-110879]
